lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: You're back. Listen: the chapel bell. Nobody has rung it in three weeks, and this morning it rang on its own.

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Tell me plainly. What waited in the crypt?

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: A blade in the dark, carrying off names. Then the ones it took are free, wherever they are. Take this; it's what the village could gather. [Received 300 gold.]

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: And this. My father carried it through the old war and swore it brought him home. [Received a Soul Gem.]
